title: The Database Disaster Test
facebook_comment_text: The discussion here is fascinating. While geo-replication gives immense security, the actual "restore" process for some legacy systems can still trip up on application configuration or dependent service re-initialization, even with perfect data integrity. 💡 How often do you fully *dry-run* a complete system restoration with non-technical stakeholders present to feel the real-world RTO? 🤔
